_note: Definition of Done, in three parts. The `py.*` commands are exactly the steps of `cd backend && make gate` and the jobs of .github/workflows/backend-ci.yaml. The `infra.*` commands run from the repository root (there is no root Makefile) and are exactly the delivery-scripts job of .github/workflows/infra-ci.yaml and the matching pre-commit hooks. Change one, change its pair (.claude/rules/ci-conventions.md §5). `infra.shell-lint` used to be here, and is now `repo.shell-lint`: the infra form named two globs under `infra/scripts/` and so proved nothing about the shell this repository ships anywhere else — both container entry points were outside it and both were red the first time a gate opened them (SC2086 in backend/docker/entrypoint.sh, SC2016 in client_flutter/docker/entrypoint.sh). `repo.secrets` moved from backend-ci for the same reason in the other direction: that workflow is `paths:`-scoped to `backend/**`, while root SECURITY.md and docs/compliance/VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT.md both claimed secret scanning on every pull request, which was false for a frontend-only or client-only one. A check whose subject is any file in this repository cannot be correct in a scoped workflow. The `frontend.*` commands are exactly the steps of `cd frontend && make gate` and of the `quality` and `tests` jobs in .github/workflows/frontend-ci.yaml (GGU-91, spec `frontend/0001`). That workflow also has a `build` job that compiles the release web bundle, which is deliberately NOT in the gate for the same reason backend-ci's `image` job is not in `py.*`: it is slow and belongs on a runner. `frontend.test` and `frontend.coverage` are make targets for the same reason `py.quality` is — the command is a loop over four packages, and a paraphrase of a loop is exactly the drift §5 warns about. `repo.*` commands also run from the repository root and are the jobs of .github/workflows/repo-ci.yaml, which carries no `paths:` filter because a repository-wide check placed in a scoped workflow runs only when that scope changes — exactly when it is least needed. `repo.spelling` runs through a script because the bare `codespell` form did not scan what it claimed: the tool's directory walk skips dot-entries, so `.claude/` and `.github/` were never opened while this note said they were. It is here because `make gate` scanned only `backend/` while the pre-commit hook scanned everything: a typo in `specs/`, root `docs/` or `.claude/` passed the gate and was caught only at commit time, and only if the author had not bypassed the hook. The `_candidates` below belong to the older `client_flutter/` app and are untouched by GGU-91.
